harmony: Achromatic neutrals (0% saturation) carry every surface and all body text. Exactly one chromatic pair sits on top: signal blue (hue 222) as primary, links, and pass states, and ember orange (hue 28, near-complementary at 194 degrees apart) as the single warm accent for highlights and mixed states. Gate red (hue 3-6) is reserved for rejected states only, so hue carries verdict meaning and is never decorative.
